_meta.description: Predefined local rules used to flag possible risk and compliance considerations for the Product Discovery Agent demo. These are teaching examples, not a substitute for legal, security, or compliance review.

risks.reason: New theme must maintain WCAG AA contrast ratios; risk of regressions if not tested.
risks.recommended_review: Accessibility/design QA pass on both themes

risks.reason: New client introduces additional attack surface (local storage, device auth, API tokens on device).
risks.recommended_review: Security review of mobile auth and local data storage

risks.reason: Push notifications and device permissions may collect additional device-level data.
risks.recommended_review: Privacy review of data collected via mobile SDKs

risks.reason: App store review and update cycles add an external dependency to release timelines.
risks.recommended_review: Release process planning with mobile platform teams

risks.reason: Call recordings and transcripts may contain sensitive customer or personal information.
risks.recommended_review: Legal/privacy review of transcript storage, retention, and deletion policy

risks.reason: Transcripts sent to a third-party summarization model introduce data-sharing considerations.
risks.recommended_review: Security review of any third-party AI processing vendor

risks.reason: Users may not realize calls are being summarized by AI unless clearly disclosed.
Changes to the first-run experience can affect activation metrics broadly if misconfigured.
Exported documents may be treated as official records depending on customer use case.
risks.recommended_review: Confirm export disclaimers/branding meet compliance expectations for regulated customers

risks.reason: Exported files leaving the platform are no longer covered by in-app access controls.
risks.recommended_review: Confirm export permissions align with existing data-access roles
